Het vergrendelen van objecten voorkomt d: Locking objects prevents other users from changing them until they are unlocked. You can optionally give a process name to say why they are locked, and a duration after which they are unlocked automatically. Only the user who locked the objects or an administrator can unlock them before the duration ends.
